title: Arvel Skeen
description: After spending a rough time in brutal Imperial prisons, Arvel Skeen became a soldier of fortune, working for a cause but also for himself. His interest in rebellion against the Empire stemmed purely from his interest in exacting revenge against the wrongs that had been done to him in the past. He butted heads with Cassian Andor early in their mission on Aldhani and they never found better footing.
